title: The harness must reject a worker that rewrites a file instead of appending to it
goal: Observed: the worker assigned to append one test to tests/gmcp_requirements.rs replaced the whole file - 13764 lines deleted, 95 added - and the acceptance still passed because it only ran the new test, so the mission reported done on a patch that destroyed the file's other 13.7k lines of acceptance tests. The adapter already compares against the base; it must also bound what an attempt may remove: an attempt that deletes more lines than it adds beyond a configured allowance is rejected as a semantic failure (the patch is not kept, the message names the deleted file and counts) rather than accepted. A legitimate large rewrite needs a task that says so.
